findings.title: Session kept in localStorage: initPro runs in legacy-bearer mode on a hosted app

applicability.reason: Hosted at tasks-demo.proappstore.online (deploy.yml uploads to apps/tasks-demo/)

evidence.observation: No authMode option — the SDK default is legacy-bearer, so the session token is cached under localStorage['pas:session']

findings.impact: Any script on the app origin can read the platform session token and drive every SDK call as the user; the secret proxy is also unavailable in this mode.
findings.remediation: Pass authMode: 'platform-cookie' in web/src/lib/app.ts; remove any code that reads app.auth.token; verify sign-in, one data call and sign-out on the live app.
acceptance_tests: document.cookie contains no session on the live app

findings.title: list_tasks returns every organisation's rows: org_id is filtered only by a client-supplied param

applicability.reason: Ready app: orgs table + org_members table in migrations.json; list_tasks is requires_auth: true

evidence.excerpt: SELECT id, title FROM tasks WHERE org_id = :org_id AND :__user_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT :limit
evidence.observation: :__user_id appears only in a tautology; nothing ties org_id to the caller's membership

findings.impact: Any signed-in platform user can read any organisation's tasks by guessing or enumerating org ids.
findings.remediation: Rewrite the predicate as WHERE org_id = :org_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM org_members m WHERE m.org_id = tasks.org_id AND m.user_id = :__user_id); re-register on deploy.
acceptance_tests: Cross-tenant negative test: a member of org A calling list_tasks with org B's id receives zero rows

applicability.reason: mcp.json declares no tool with requires_auth: false (14 tools, all requires_auth: true)

findings.title: Live sign-in, sign-out and role-change verification not yet performed by a person

applicability.reason: Hosted app with GitHub sign-in and app roles (coach, member)

evidence.observation: Checklist from PAS-AUTH-020 attached; the auditor gathered no live results because this clause is Human-verified

findings.notes: An AI auditor must not mark this clause pass; a person runs the checklist and records the outcome.
